Each line is one kind of tactic. Every tactic is a station on its line.

  1. PTurning people against youIsolating you, using other people, and controlling who hears what.22
  2. TTwisting what is realLies, denial and confusion that leave you unsure of your own memory or judgment.46
  3. BDodging blameWays a person avoids responsibility, or turns it back on you.26
  4. SWork, school and systemsWhen an organization, its rules or its paperwork become the weapon.61
  5. CControl over your lifeRules, monitoring and limits on your time, money, body or choices.50
  6. GGuilt, pressure and fearPushing you to say yes through guilt, obligation, urgency or threat.53
  7. LLove that hooks youAffection, attention and promises used to pull you in and keep you there.31
  8. WPut-downs that wear you downInsults, contempt and slow erosion of how you see yourself.28

  10. OOnline and technologyFake accounts, deepfakes, tracking, scams and pressure through screens.25
